test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All trams are cows.

No cow is a bun.

Conclusions:

(I): No tram is a bun.

(II): Some buns are cows.
solution:
Given Statements:

All trams are cows.

No cow is a bun.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64cc519b36e050f9af14ac6d6849a726d0e55897ac62471f6acb2e1116220962.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No tram is a bun.

Since all Trams are inside the set of Cows (Statement 1), and the entire set of Cows is separate from the Buns (Statement 2), it is impossible for any Tram to be a Bun.

Conclusion (I) logically follows (is true).

II. Some buns are cows.

Statement 2 explicitly states: "No cow is a bun," meaning there is zero overlap between Cows and Buns.

Conclusion (II) directly contradicts this, as it suggests some overlap exists.

Conclusion (II) does not follow (is false).

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
